purpose: Provide a reproducible, low-risk fixture for the first end-to-end ChatGPT Skills execution test.
prompt: Explain this to a non-specialist software product manager who must decide whether retry behavior is safe to enable: An API client implements exponential backoff with jitter; requests are retried on HTTP 429 and 5xx responses up to five times; mutation endpoints must use idempotency keys; retries can improve resilience but may increase tail latency and amplify load during partial outages.
required_behaviors: State the practical decision or implication before deep technical detail.
Preserve material caveats instead of simplifying them away.
Define required technical terms while keeping the exact searchable terminology.
Include a comprehension or teach-back check.
Leave a reusable glossary or explanation artifact.
Do not claim the retry policy is universally safe or optimal without context.
promotion_rule: Only promote execution evidence from designed to tested after the exact versioned skill is loaded on a qualifying ChatGPT Skills surface and the same-chat output satisfies this fixture without undeclared external dependencies.
